turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Hi! I want you to help me keep track of family stuff, so here's the basic picture.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: We live at 4417 NE Brookside Ave in Portland. My husband Tom is an ER nurse at Halverson Medical Center. He works nights Wednesday, Thursday and Friday, 7 pm to 7 am, and sleeps until about 2 pm after a shift.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Got it. Should I avoid scheduling anything for Tom on those days before mid-afternoon?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Exactly. Our daughter Lily is nine, in 4th grade at Maplewood Elementary, Ms. Alvarez's class in Room 14. School lets out at 2:50.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Pepper is our beagle, she's six. Her vet is Dr. Ana Huang at Larchmont Animal Hospital.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Greg Pullman next door at 4421 has our spare key.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: And me: I'm a UX research lead at Fernhill Software. I'm in the office Tuesdays and Thursdays and work from home the rest of the week.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. I'll keep office days Tuesday and Thursday in mind when I suggest times.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: A few things about Tom while I think of them.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: He's allergic to penicillin, that one matters if he ever needs antibiotics. His cell is (503) 555-0161.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Food-wise he loves Thai and anything spicy, and he can't stand cilantro.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: His best friend from college, Owen Fischer, lives in Vancouver, in Kitsilano.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Thanks. Penicillin allergy, no cilantro, and Owen in Vancouver. Anything about his schedule beyond the night shifts?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: He does a mandatory training day once a month, usually the first Tuesday, 8 to 4.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Priya had an allergic reaction at her office party tonight. There was shrimp in the dumplings and nobody said.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Oh no, is she okay?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: She's fine, an antihistamine and a very itchy hour. But it turns out she's allergic to all shellfish, cooked or raw: shrimp, crab, lobster, scallops. Her allergist made it official last spring and she carries an epinephrine auto-injector now.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Please remember that whenever we plan food with her.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I will. Anything else about Priya I should know for planning?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: She hates phone calls, always text her. She's an architect at Okafor & Lind, her partner is Dev Shah, and her birthday is March 28. She lives at 1835 NE Alder St for now.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Noted: text rather than call, birthday March 28.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Lily's winter concert is Wednesday the 17th at 6 pm in the school gym. She plays the recorder, heaven help us.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Homework routine: reading log 20 minutes every night, signed by a parent on Fridays.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I'll remind you to sign the reading log on Friday evenings.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Thank you, I always forget until Monday morning.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Work context for you. I'm leading the Atlas study: it's research on the new onboarding flow for Tandem, our scheduling app.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: My manager is Jordan Hale, Director of Design. We have a 1:1 every Monday at 11.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Marcus Lee is our research coordinator, he recruits the participants. Dana Kim is in research ops and handles incentives and tools.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Thanks. Do you want me to protect Monday 11:00 for your 1:1 with Jordan?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes please, it never moves.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Holiday gift list, can you keep it for me? Budget is about $600 total.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Lily: a real watercolor set and Moon Fox book 5. Tom: a good chef's knife. Mom: a photo calendar with pictures of Lily. Priya: the fig candle she liked. Greg and June next door: a tin of my ginger cookies.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Saved. Do you want me to track which ones you've bought?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes. I already ordered the calendar and the candle.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Some health stuff about Lily so you never get it wrong.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: She's allergic to sesame, diagnosed when she was four. There's an epinephrine auto-injector in the front pocket of her backpack and a second one in the kitchen drawer next to the fridge.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Her allergist is Dr. Okonkwo at Willow Creek Pediatrics, and her pediatrician is Dr. Sato at the same practice.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Watch out for tahini, hummus, sesame oil and seeded buns. Always ask restaurants what oil they use.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Understood. Any other food issues?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: She can't stand mushrooms, but that's just picky, not an allergy.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Lily's winter break is December 22 to January 2.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: I signed her up for the art camp at Clay & Code, December 29 to 31, 9 to 3 each day. It's $165 and already paid.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Got it. Should I remind you about drop-off times that week?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes, the night before each day is fine.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Christmas Eve is at Tom's brother Luis's place in Beaverton, 5 pm. Luis and his wife Carmen have two kids, Mateo who's seven and Sofia who's four.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: I'm bringing dessert. I want to make a pear tart, but dairy-free, I'm lactose intolerant.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: A pear and almond tart with an olive-oil crust would work without dairy. Want the recipe?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes. Also Luis is doing a Korean menu, so I told him no sesame oil on anything Lily eats.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Good call. I'll send the tart recipe now.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Pepper had her annual shots on Thursday, all done for the year.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: She eats the salmon and rice kibble, one cup twice a day. Dr. Huang wants her to lose about two pounds, she's 26 lb right now. No more table scraps.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Noted. Want me to remind the family about no table scraps when guests are over?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Ha, mostly remind Tom.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Christmas recap: Luis's Korean dinner was amazing and he kept Lily's plate sesame-free.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Lily loved the watercolor set, Tom loved the knife. Mom's photo calendar arrived late, it'll get to her by New Year.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Tom's parents called from Phoenix. Ana and Ricardo want to visit in the summer. We call them most Sundays.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Lovely. Want me to note a summer visit from Ana and Ricardo as tentative?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes, tentative, no dates yet.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Little end-of-year admin dump.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Our car is the blue 2019 hatchback. Its registration renewal is due April 30.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Tom's birthday is April 11. I'd love to plan something for it this year.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: New Year resolutions: run 5 km with Priya on Sunday mornings, and keep going to physio for my left shoulder. That's Monday mornings at 7:30 at Kestrel Physio, booked through the end of March.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I'll keep Monday 7:30 clear for physio through March. For Tom's birthday, shall I collect ideas as you think of them?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes, keep a list.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Some health admin for me. My doctor is Dr. Lewis at Hawthorne Family Medicine, and I'm due for my annual physical in April.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: I take vitamin D every morning, and I wear contacts. New contacts get ordered in May.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Shall I remind you to book the physical in early April?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes, the first week of April, but not while we're in Vancouver.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Just talked to my mom. Her doctor says her A1C went up again. She has type 2 diabetes.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: She's cutting out sugar and white rice: brown rice, beans, lots of vegetables. She even gave up flan.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: That's a big change. Should I keep that in mind for meals when she visits?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes, we'll cook low-sugar when she stays with us. Also her knee is still bad since her knee surgery in October, stairs are really hard for her.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: So when she comes she'll sleep in the den downstairs on the sofa bed, not in the guest room upstairs.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: She's thinking of visiting in late March, around Lily's spring break.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: For the record: my mom is Elena Ruiz, she lives in Sacramento, she's a retired second-grade teacher, and her birthday is June 14.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Thanks. I'll plan around the den and low-sugar meals for her visit.

title: Mom - medications and doctors
text: Elena (Mom): metformin 500 mg twice a day, with breakfast and with dinner. Lisinopril 10 mg every morning for blood pressure. Checks her blood sugar every morning before breakfast. Doctor in Sacramento: Dr. Meera Patel. Bring her pill organizer from the bathroom to the kitchen when she stays with us.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: I'm going to Austin for the Field Research Forum in February, the 17th to the 19th. I'm giving a talk on the 18th.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Tom works Wednesday and Thursday nights that week, so Luis and Carmen will keep Lily overnight on the 18th.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Got it. Want me to put the trip and Lily's overnight at Luis's on the calendar?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes please. The flight details will come by email.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Work news: I'm hiring a junior UX researcher. Interviews are the week of January 26.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Exciting. Do you want interview blocks held that week?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes, hold Tuesday and Thursday afternoons, 1 to 4.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Tom checked all our passports for the Vancouver trip. Lily's expired last month, on December 9.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Ah. Do you want a reminder to start the renewal?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes, I'll do the paperwork this weekend. She needs a new photo first. Tom's passport is good until 2029 and mine until 2027, so it's only hers.

title: Atlas study plan (v2)
text: Goal: find where new Tandem users drop out of onboarding. 12 participants, 60-minute remote sessions, February 9 to March 6. Incentive: $75 gift card per participant, handled by Dana Kim. Recruiting and scheduling: Marcus Lee. Three research questions: account setup friction, calendar connection, first shared schedule.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: The dishwasher died. A repair tech from Rose Appliance is coming Wednesday the 21st between noon and 4.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Also I ordered tomato and basil seeds for the garden. Planting in May, after the last frost.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Noted the repair visit on Wednesday January 21, noon to 4.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Jordan just told me leadership wants the Atlas readout before the end of Q1. We're aiming for Tuesday March 24.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: It's 30 minutes plus Q&A, and they want the top three recommendations up front.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Shall I block prep time in the week before March 24?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Not yet, sessions only end in early March. Marcus is recruiting the 12 participants now.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Sure, the day before.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Updated. I'll use (916) 555-0172 for your mom from now on.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: And she booked her flight! She lands in Portland on Tuesday March 24 at 11:50 in the morning and flies home Thursday April 2.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Wonderful. Want me to put the pickup on your calendar?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Later, closer to the date.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Book club at our place next Thursday, eight people.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Jess is vegan and Marie is gluten-free, so I'll do a big lentil salad and a flourless chocolate cake.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: That covers both. Do you want a shopping list for Wednesday?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes, and remind me to borrow two folding chairs from Greg.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: We hired Imani Cole as our junior UX researcher! She starts March 2.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: I'll be her mentor. We'll do a weekly 1:1 on Wednesdays at 2 pm once she starts.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Congratulations! I'll add the Wednesday 2 pm 1:1 starting the week of March 2.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno

turns.text: That is tight. Shall I set a check-in for March 27? If it hasn't arrived by then you could call the passport agency for an appointment.

title: Shipping update - Kiln & Co
author: Kiln & Co
text: Order KC-3390: hand-thrown teapot, glaze 'sea fog'. Shipped March 16. Estimated delivery: Wednesday, March 25, to 4417 NE Brookside Ave, Portland.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Took Pepper to Dr. Huang this morning, ear infection again, left ear.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: She gets ear drops twice a day, morning and night, through Sunday. She hates it.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: If she's still shaking her head on Sunday we call the clinic. Otherwise the recheck is Monday the 30th at 5:15.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I'll remind you about the drops morning and night through Sunday March 22, and about the recheck on March 30 at 5:15 pm.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Tom found a permission slip in Lily's backpack for the science museum field trip on the 27th.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: It needs a parent signature and $12 cash, due Friday. I'm swamped tonight.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Want me to remind you on Thursday?

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Yes please, Thursday evening.

title: Priya's birthday
text: Dinner Saturday March 28, 7:30 pm, Olive & Ash on Belmont. NOT booked yet; they only take reservations by phone: (503) 555-0147. Gift: the teapot from Kiln & Co (arriving the 25th). Wrap it and drop it off at her new place before Saturday.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Dana says the last two Atlas participants are scheduled for Friday and she'll send me the final participant list Monday morning.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: Also Tom booked the car in at Eastside Auto Care for Saturday at 9 am, oil change and tire rotation. I'm taking it, he'll be asleep after his Friday shift.

turns.speaker: Rachel Moreno
turns.text: And Kendra still hasn't answered about swapping April 3. Tom will ask Mike if she says no.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Got it: final list from Dana on Monday, the car on Saturday at 9, and Tom's April 3 shift still open.
